Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 104: Holiday 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #104 shipped to subscribers in December 2009 (bearing the cover date of Holiday 2009 or January 2010 for Issue 104). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #104 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media previews:

Battlefield: Bad Company 2 (tactical squad-based FPS)
Just Cause 2 (open-world action-adventure)
Sonic & SEGA All-Stars Racing (kart racing)
Dynasty Warriors: Strikeforce (action hack-and-slash)
Matt Hazard: Blood Bath and Beyond (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling shooter)
Darwinia+ (Xbox Live Arcade real-time strategy/action)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Halo: Reach, Dead Rising 2, and Medal of Honor, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
